statement_made: I’m ready to be on a field where I’m wanted and we can actually compete for something.
event_description: Addressing trade rumors and his desire to move on from the Las Vegas Raiders.

statement_made: No shirt, no problem. Just enjoying the game like a fan for once.
event_description: Going viral for jumping out of a suite shirtless during the Bills-Chiefs playoff game.

statement_made: Stripes missed a clear hold on that final drive, but I’m the one getting fined for talking about it? Crazy.
event_description: Criticizing officiating after a late-game loss and subsequent league fine.

statement_made: Tank Dell is the heart of this team. We’re playing every snap for him while he recovers.
event_description: Expressing solidarity with his teammate following a season-ending injury.

statement_made: Ten years in Dallas... I’ve seen it all, but the job isn’t done until we bring a trophy home.
event_description: Reflecting on his decade-long career with the Cowboys during a contract extension interview.

statement_made: I was on the couch eating popcorn two weeks ago. Now we’re in the playoffs. Life comes at you fast.
event_description: Commenting on his unexpected mid-season signing and successful run with the Browns.

statement_made: I just want to hit people and catch footballs. If that makes me 'old school,' then I’m a dinosaur.
event_description: Defending his physical playstyle amidst concerns about longevity and injury risk.

statement_made: This city and this team embraced me when I was at my lowest. I’m not going anywhere.
event_description: Confirming his decision to re-sign with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after a career resurgence.

statement_made: Chicago will always have a place in my heart, but it’s time to get to work in the Steel City.
event_description: Farewell message to Bears fans after being traded to the Pittsburgh Steelers.

statement_made: The King still has plenty of miles left in the tank. Don't believe the narrative.
event_description: Responding to critics who suggested his production would drop after turning 30.

statement_made: Consistency is the only stat I truly care about. Eleven years of 1K is for the fans.
event_description: Reflecting on extending his NFL record of consecutive 1,000-yard receiving seasons.

statement_made: Counting the names of the 16 receivers drafted before me never gets old. It’s fuel.
event_description: Discussing his continued motivation years after being a fourth-round pick.

statement_made: The body tells you when to slow down, but the mind won’t listen. We’re going for it all.
event_description: Reflecting on his workload and injury management during a Super Bowl run.

statement_made: I need to be smarter with my health. I owe it to my family and my teammates to be on the field.
event_description: Addressing his history with concussions and a new commitment to safer sliding techniques.

statement_made: They wrote me off, I ain't write back though. That's for anyone who ever doubted themselves.
event_description: The viral post-game quote following a breakout victory as the Seahawks starter.

statement_made: Individual sacks don’t mean a thing without the ring. That’s the only stat I’m chasing now.
event_description: Discussing his career goals as he nears the end of his professional journey.

statement_made: Getting back to 100% was a mountain, but the view is worth it. I’m just grateful to play.
event_description: Reflecting on his return from a complex hamstring injury and surgery.

statement_made: Coming back to Seattle felt like coming home. I never should have left, but it made me better.
event_description: Reflecting on his return to the Seahawks after a season with the Rams.

statement_made: The DPOY race shouldn't be about popularity. Look at the tape. The impact is undeniable.
event_description: Expressing frustration over perceived media bias in defensive award voting.

statement_made: Told them I’m a wide-back. They finally starting to believe me now that everyone’s trying it.
event_description: Joking about his unique position and how other teams are trying to replicate his hybrid role.
